label: D1 reward-received, late in the episode, after an unrewarded trial or an a2 choice
explanation: Fires only at D1 and essentially only when the reward input is 1 (D1 & in_rew==1 has recall 0.999, mass recall 1.0, but precision 0.087). It never fires at GO or D2, or after an unrewarded trial. Within rewarded D1 steps the rate climbs steeply with episode trial (0.2% in trials 0-9, 8.8% in trials 90-99), so it tracks low model value late in the episode. It is also strongly biased toward a2/S2 choices and toward rewards that follow an unrewarded trial: the largest activations (1.0) are the first reward after one or more r0 trials, and activation decays over consecutive rewards (e.g. 0.96 then 0.17 then 0). Before trial 80, a reward that follows another reward almost never activates it. Recorded predicate (dev F1 0.46, mass recall 0.75): rewarded D1, ep_trial>=70, and either the trial before was unrewarded or the previous choice was a2. Simpler alternatives: rewarded D1 & ep_trial>=70 (F1 0.37, mass 0.76); rewarded D1 & ep_trial>=80 & prev_action==2 (F1 0.49, mass 0.43). Uses only observed variables. Magnitude increases with reward surprise (reward after non-reward) and lateness, but precision stays incomplete.
